title: Boyd and Stephanie Householder
excerpt: Editorial research draft about Boyd and Stephanie Householder, founders of Circle of Hope Girls' Ranch in Missouri. Boyd died in 2024 before trial; Stephanie pleaded guilty in 2025 to child abuse or neglect and endangering a child.

meta.person_role: Founders of Circle of Hope Girls' Ranch (Cedar County, Missouri); Boyd formerly worked at Agape Boarding School

person_notable_work: Ran an unlicensed religious girls' ranch closed in 2020 after state removals
Charged with nearly 100 counts between them in 2021
Their case helped drive Missouri's 2021 oversight law
